notes: Dimensions, mass and the full display table come from AYANEO's own spec-sheet IMAGE on the ayaneo.com product page (.../product/2025/AYANEO_Pocket_DS/EN/07.webp), read visually — the product page HTML carries no text specs. AYANEO prints one size, '179.8*101.8*25mm (34.4mm at the grip)' = folded/closed state → dimensions_mm.closed; no open-state dimension is published (null). 34.4mm 'at the grip' is a grip bulge, not a hinge thickness → depth_at_hinge null. AXIS ORDERING: 179.8mm is the long edge (landscape width in use), recorded as `height` per the OEM-ordering rule. active_area_mm derived from sourced diagonal + sourced resolution: 25.4*D*w/hypot(w,h) x 25.4*D*h/hypot(w,h); corroborated by AYANEO's own printed '256PPI' for the secondary screen, which matches 5in/1024x768 exactly (256.0). Main screen is OLED; secondary is LCD (AYANEO's own words). Secondary-screen refresh rate is not published (null). NO HEADPHONE JACK: AYANEO's Port row lists ONLY '1 × Full-function USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-C' and '1 × Micro SD slot' — no 3.5mm jack is listed anywhere on AYANEO's page, so none is recorded (this is a real difference from the Windows FLIP DS / FLIP 1S DS, both of which do list a 3.5mm jack). stick/trigger/bumper counts are not stated by AYANEO → null rather than guessed. DATES: AYANEO published two separate events — pre-orders/Indiegogo pre-launch opened 2025-07-29 (recorded as `announced`, and the earliest AYANEO-dated article for this product) and AYANEO's own article titled '...AYANEO Pocket DS Officially Released' is dated 2025-08-18 (recorded as `released`). Because this was a crowdfunded launch these are the announce and availability dates respectively; note AYANEO's direct store listing (shop.ayaneo.com/products/ayaneo-pocket-ds-g3x-gen2) was not published until 2025-10-28, which is when it reached AYANEO's own retail channel. SoC Qualcomm Snapdragon G3x Gen 2; OS Android 13 — hence the 'G3x Gen2' alias AYANEO uses in its store SKU name. external_ids.igdb_platform null: Android device, not an IGDB games platform.
